biggest_catch: This is gambling, not income: PredictIt is a betting venue where shares can go to $0, the 10% profit fee plus 5% withdrawal fee make it negative-sum for traders, and there is no guaranteed payout of any kind.
catches: Prediction markets are gambling: Yes/No shares are priced 1c-99c and settle at $1 or $0; losing shares are worthless.

PredictIt takes a 10% fee on profits (confirmed in the CFTC no-action filing record and PredictIt's official support documentation) AND a 5% fee on withdrawals, so even winning traders keep meaningfully less than they 'won'.

Per-market position caps apply (CFTC filing records $850 per market historically; a 2026 third-party review reports $3,500 per contract after the 2025 national relaunch - confirm in current official terms), limiting how much anyone can put at risk or win.
No bonuses or promotions are advertised; the catalog claim is only 'check current site for active promos', which is honest but means there is no promo payout to claim.
There is no mobile app; trading is via the predictit.org website only.
Outcomes depend on uncertain real-world events; no prediction strategy guarantees profit.
Addiction risk: real-money event betting with uncertain outcomes.
